note: Execution classes are capability boundaries, not authority. Every external mutation still needs explicit task-local authorization at execution time.

steps.action: Capture explicit task-local authorization for qcax/qcax-fabric creation/mutation and intended public visibility.
Recheck global/installed repositories for exact qcax/qcax-fabric name immediately before creation.
steps.notes: Search itself can run before creation; class indicates connector-executable task. If repo still absent, continue.
steps.required_evidence: search receipt showing exact collision state

steps.action: Create public qcax/qcax-fabric with only a minimal README so main exists; do not auto-add license/gitignore.
Read repository metadata and main head; verify owner=qcax, visibility=public, no unexpected starter files.
Create bootstrap/v0.1.0-alpha.1 from main.
Upload the exact reviewed R4.4 repo tree as one atomic tree/commit on bootstrap branch.
Open draft bootstrap PR to main and record exact head/base SHAs.
Re-resolve every enabled workflow action tag/ref to a current full commit SHA and compare to ACTION_PIN_LEDGER.
Patch workflows-ready pins only when fresh resolution differs; run local workflow/static validation.
Copy reviewed ci/conformance/dependency-review workflows into .github/workflows on bootstrap branch.
Observe bootstrap PR Actions runs and required check context names; do not invent ruleset checks before they exist.
Patch only demonstrated CI portability defects; rerun affected jobs until passing or exact blocker.
Set squash-only merge and auto-delete head branches; disable merge commits and rebase merge for a single canonical history.
Enable Issues; disable Wiki; enable Discussions only after bootstrap if useful; set description/topics.
Enable dependency graph, Dependabot alerts, and security updates.
Enable private vulnerability reporting.
Enable secret scanning and push protection when available for this public repository/account.
Enable CodeQL default setup; use advanced workflow only if later custom queries/build needs justify it.
Set default workflow token permissions to read-only and disable Actions ability to approve PRs.
Restrict allowed Actions to GitHub-owned plus reviewed full-SHA third-party actions; do not allow mutable tags in enabled workflows.
Create main ruleset in Evaluate mode using the observed check names; 0 approvals during solo-maintainer bootstrap.
Main rules: require PR, required checks, conversation resolution, linear history; block deletion and force push; no routine bypass.
Promote main ruleset from Evaluate to Active only after bootstrap checks are stable.
Create v* tag ruleset that restricts update/deletion and reserves creation to maintainers/release flow.
Install CODEOWNERS with @qcax for routing only; do not call it independent review.
Verify issue forms, PR template, SECURITY, CONTRIBUTING, GOVERNANCE, SUPPORT, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CITATION, LICENSE/NOTICE on PR.
Enable exact-pinned dependency review gate with fail-on-severity=high; defer strict licence allowlist until live dependency metadata proves it safe.
Enable exact-pinned OpenSSF Scorecard scheduled/main workflow after public bootstrap; upload SARIF only with minimal required permissions.
steps.required_evidence: Scorecard run + score, no certification claim

steps.action: Review bootstrap PR diff, CI, dependency review, security results, and source-manifest parity; record go/no-go.
Merge bootstrap PR only if gate passes and exact head SHA has not moved.
Read main tree/commit and verify exact reviewed files, hashes, enabled workflows, and no unexpected mutation.
Verify v0.1.0-alpha.1 tag does not exist and re-run full main CI from clean checkout.
Build wheels, schemas, base lock manifest, conformance bundle and checksums in unprivileged release-build job from exact commit.
Generate SPDX SBOM using recorded tool/spec and validate it; keep SBOM separate from security certification.
Generate GitHub build provenance attestations for release artifacts and verify them.
Create draft GitHub prerelease v0.1.0-alpha.1 from exact main commit.
Attach every final asset before publication: wheels, lock manifest, schemas, conformance bundle, SBOM, hashes, source archive/receipts.
Enable/confirm immutable release semantics before publication; immutable release is an alpha exit gate, not optional.
Publish immutable prerelease only after asset completeness gate; then verify release and every asset.
steps.required_evidence: published immutable release + gh release verify/verify-asset outputs

steps.action: Install alpha assets into clean environment using release lock; recompute InstalledImageIdentity and run out-of-tree plugin canary.
Check availability/ownership of all intended PyPI distribution names before creating Trusted Publishers.
Create protected GitHub pypi environment with no long-lived API token; require approval only where platform/account makes it non-deadlocking.
Configure PyPI Trusted Publisher for exact owner/repo/workflow/environment and package names.
Enable exact-pinned PyPI publish workflow; publishing job only downloads prebuilt release artifacts and publishes with OIDC.
Publish PEP 440 0.1.0a1 packages only after immutable GitHub alpha passes; record PyPI file hashes and PEP 740 attestations.
Install published packages in clean environment, verify release-lock/InstalledImageIdentity, and rerun conformance/out-of-tree canary.
Pin and implement real Inspect adapter against public QCAX contracts without host imports.
Pin and implement real Cordis or LangGraph adapter as structurally different second canary.
Run shared held-out protocol suite and measure portability/operator cost; keep external failures separate from core failures.
Implement SANDBOXED_PROCESS execution mode before admitting untrusted plugins; do not treat in-process permissions as isolation.
Migrate remaining first-party systems in waves behind contracts; prohibit host special-cases and cross-plugin implementation imports.
Promote application profiles only after their required plugins/adapters have independent evidence; preserve target isolation.
When a second eligible maintainer exists, raise critical-path approval requirement to >=1 independent/code-owner review.
Run periodic action-pin revalidation/Dependabot github-actions updates; do not assume SHA refs automatically receive all vulnerability alerts.
Record final repository/settings/rulesets/workflows/release/package/attestation state in detached evidence ledger.
Apply R31 generation fence: absorb predecessor publication evidence once; do not let own release create an automatic successor.
Reopen affected partitions only on independent evidence, validation failure, source/version drift, provider capability change, or explicit user objective change.
Declare v0.1.0-alpha.1 working GitHub base only when mandatory GitHub alpha gates are actually evidenced; PyPI and real external adapters remain separate post-alpha gates.
